title: The Difference Between Fear and Knowing
core_idea: Fear and intuition can feel alike; fear tends to be loud and urgent, while a deeper knowing is usually calm, steady and patient.
text: How do you tell the difference between a warning from within and an old fear wearing its clothes? Both can make your heart beat faster. Both can say, not this way. But many people notice they move differently. Fear tends to be loud. It rushes, repeats itself, and paints the worst picture it can find. A deeper knowing is often quieter. It doesn't argue or threaten. It simply stays, steady, even after you've calmed down. So when something inside you says no, you might wait a little while. Breathe. Let the noise settle. Then ask again, gently. What remains when the panic has passed is often worth listening to.
description: A gentle reflection on telling the difference between fear and a quieter inner knowing.
